summary: Specifies a protocol for checking whether an endpoint can receive multicast traffic, both source-specific and any-source. It can also gather information such as the time to set up a multicast tree. It is based on the ssmping and asmping tools.

eli5.summary: Multicast sends one stream to many viewers. But how do you know yours will arrive? This is a ping for that: it checks you can actually receive the group stream.
